name: RTranslator
tagline: Talk to someone in another language, live
description:
RTranslator listens while two people talk and translates for both of them in real time. Put in one earbud each, and you can hold a normal conversation even when you don't share a language.

The translation runs on your phone instead of a company's servers, so it works without internet and nothing you say is sent away. It can also translate text you type or speech from a single speaker.
